title: 第521章 美女老祖 vs 女帝第520章 大乾女帝姜璇玑
content_zh:
第521章美女老祖vs女帝
“若是能汲取她的九阴元阴，哪怕只是一部分，我的纯阳道体，便可再次进阶！”
周尘的眼神在那道端坐于金色车辇之上的明黄身影上停留了许久，心中一阵火热。
到那时候，自己的肉身强度将达到一个匪夷所思的地步，寻常天阶灵器都难以伤他分毫。
纯阳灵力将蕴含一缕先天道韵，出手之间便可引动天地灵气共鸣，战力暴涨数倍不止。
不仅如此，吸收了九阴元阴之后，自己修为境界恐怕也会随之飙升。
如今自己已经是神海境七重巅峰，剑王九重巅峰，若再进一步，便可双双踏入更高的层次。
他默默在心中复盘自身道体如今的境界，心中盘算得一清二楚。
眼下自己还只是纯阳霸体巅峰，不过之前与君倾月双修，汲取她的元阴后，根基早已铺垫完毕，只要他愿意，随时随地都能顺势突破，晋升更为强横的纯阳灵体。
只不过，当时他忙于升级先天剑瞳，后来又忙于寻找先天剑骨，便将这件事情暂时搁置了。
毕竟，升级先天剑瞳和寻找先天剑骨，都是关乎他自身根基的大事，马虎不得。
而纯阳道体的进阶，虽然也很重要，但却不是迫在眉睫的事情。
反正纯阳灵体就在那里，跑不掉，早一天晚一天升级，区别并不大。
可现在，看到这位大乾女帝姜璇玑，他心中的那团火，又重新燃烧了起来！
“要是真能拿下，到时候，我的纯阳道体说不定真的能够突破现有的瓶颈，进化到更高的层次！”
他还想象着，自己若是真的与女帝双修，那岂不是就成了姜瑾瑜的……继父？
这个念头一冒出来，周尘自己都吓了一跳。
“呸呸呸，我在想什么乱七八糟的！”他在心中暗骂自己一声，“八字还没一撇呢，就开始想这些有的没的。”
周尘很快就冷静了下来，因为他知道，这种事情，想想就行了，真要做起来，难度太大了。
那可是大乾女帝啊！

是整个大乾王朝最强大的存在！
是统御十三州、威压四海的至尊！
是踏入了涅槃境的绝世强者！
而他，如今名义上，还只是青云剑宗的一个普通弟子！
一个神海境七重的小小武者！
连剑皇都还不是！
两者之间的差距，简直比天还高，比海还深！
可那个念头一旦扎根，便如同野草一般疯长，怎么也压不下去。
他不由自主地再次抬起头，目光投向天穹之上那道端坐于金色车辇之中的明黄身影。
冕旒的珠帘在风中轻轻晃动，珠帘之后，那张面容若隐若现，带着一种朦胧的美感。
她似乎察觉到了什么，微微侧过头来，目光若有若无地扫过下方的人群。
那一刻，周尘感觉自己的心跳仿佛漏了一拍。
他似乎有一种错觉，女帝的眼神，好像在自己身上停留了一瞬。
不，一定是错觉。
她怎么可能注意到自己？
在场数千人，自己表面上没什么特殊之处，这位大乾女帝应该只会注意凌老祖，凭什么能入她的眼？
周尘连忙低下头，不敢再与她对视。
他在心中暗暗告诫自己：“冷静，冷静。这种想法太危险了，一旦被女帝察觉，别说升级纯阳道体了，恐怕连怎么死的都不知道。”
那可是涅槃境的强者啊！
他清楚地记得羲和女帝当初说过，涅槃境与通天境之间，隔着一道天堑。
content_en:
Chapter 521 Beauty Ancestor vs Empress
"If I can absorb even a part of her Nine Yin Yuan Yin, my Pure Yang Dao Body can advance again!"
Zhou Chen's eyes lingered on the bright yellow figure sitting on the golden chariot for a long time, and his heart felt hot.
By that time, his physical strength will reach an incredible level, and ordinary heaven-level spiritual weapons will be unable to harm him at all.
The pure Yang spiritual power will contain a ray of innate Taoist charm, which can trigger the resonance of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in a single move, and the combat power will increase several times.
Not only that, after absorbing Jiuyin Yuanyin, his cultivation level may also soar.
Now he is already at the peak of the seventh level of the Divine Sea Realm and the ninth level of the Sword King. If he goes further, he can both step into a higher level.
He silently reviewed the current state of his Tao body in his mind, and he calculated it clearly.
At the moment, he is still at the peak of Pure Yang Spirit Body, but after dual cultivation with Jun Qingyue and absorbing her Yuan Yin, the foundation has been laid. As long as he is willing, he can break through anytime and anywhere and advance to a more powerful Pure Yang Spirit Body.
However, at that time, he was busy upgrading the innate sword pupil, and later he was busy looking for the innate sword bone, so he put this matter on hold for the time being.
After all, upgrading the innate sword pupil and finding the innate sword bone are important matters related to his own foundation, and he cannot afford to be careless.
Although the advancement of the Pure Yang Dao Body is also very important, it is not an imminent matter.
Anyway, the pure Yang spirit body is there and can't escape. There is not much difference in upgrading one day earlier and one day later.
But now, seeing the Daqian Empress Jiang Xuanji, the fire in his heart started to burn again!
"If I can really win it, then my Pure Yang Dao Body may really be able to break through the current bottleneck and evolve to a higher level!"
He also imagined that if he really practiced dual cultivation with the Empress, wouldn't he become Jiang Jinyu's... stepfather?
Zhou Chen himself was startled as soon as this idea came up.
"Bah, bah, bah, what nonsense am I thinking about!" He cursed himself in his mind, "I haven't even written my horoscope yet, and I'm starting to think about all these things."
Zhou Chen calmed down quickly, because he knew that just thinking about this kind of thing would be enough, but it would be too difficult to do it.
That is Empress Dagan!
It is the most powerful existence in the entire Daqian Dynasty!
He is the supreme ruler who rules the thirteen states and dominates the world!
He is a peerless strong man who has entered the realm of Nirvana!
And now, in name, he is just an ordinary disciple of the Qingyun Sword Sect!
A little warrior at the seventh level of the Divine Sea Realm!
Not even the Sword Emperor!
The gap between the two is simply higher than the sky and deeper than the sea!
But once that idea takes root, it grows like a weed and cannot be suppressed no matter what.
He involuntarily raised his head again and cast his gaze on the bright yellow figure sitting in the golden chariot above the sky.
The beaded curtain swayed gently in the wind. Behind the beaded curtain, the face was looming, with a hazy beauty.
She seemed to notice something, turned her head slightly, and glanced at the crowd below.
At that moment, Zhou Chen felt as if his heartbeat had skipped a beat.
He seemed to have an illusion that the empress' eyes seemed to stay on him for a moment.
No, it must be an illusion.
How could she possibly notice herself?
There were thousands of people present, and there was nothing special about her on the surface. This Empress of Daqian should only pay attention to Patriarch Ling, so why could she catch her eye?
Zhou Chen quickly lowered his head, not daring to look at her again.
He secretly warned himself in his heart: "Calm down, calm down. This kind of idea is too dangerous. Once the empress notices it, let alone upgrading the Pure Yang Dao body, I am afraid I won't even know how to die."
That is a strong man in the Nirvana realm!
He clearly remembered what Empress Xihe had said that there was a natural chasm between the Nirvana Realm and the Heavenly Realm.
